Index.harnessMetaTitle: Zelo · Open-Source Multi-Tenant SaaS Foundation for AI-Native Apps
Index.harnessMetaDesc: A standalone, open-source multi-tenant SaaS foundation with auth, RBAC, subscriptions, shared admin console, and optional governed AI Native & MCP—so you ship pluggable business Cores.
Index.harnessHeroTitlePost: Ship business Cores, not SaaS plumbing.
Index.harnessHeroDesc: Open-source multi-tenant SaaS base with auth, RBAC, subscriptions, and a shared console.
Index.harnessHeroDesc2: Connect business apps as Cores, or run and export the standalone base with zero Cores. Rental Core provides an official business package reference.
Index.harnessHeroScreenshotAlt: Zelo shared admin console and AI-native business workspace preview
Index.harnessWhyTitle:
One shared SaaS base.

Any business Core.
Index.harnessWhyP1: Zelo cleanly separates reusable multi-tenant SaaS infrastructure from pluggable industry business Cores.
Index.harnessWhyP2: Each Core owns its own domain schema, raw SQL migrations, admin UI contributions, and optional AI tools.
Index.harnessPillar1Desc: Boot and export cleanly without any industry business code—complete with multi-tenancy, org RBAC, subscriptions, encrypted integrations, and a shared admin shell.
Index.harnessPillar2Desc: Every Core declares its manifest, permissions, UI routes, OpenAPI schema, and SQL migrations, with built-in discovery, SHA-256 verification, and pinned deployment locks.
Index.harnessPillar3Desc: AI stays strictly opt-in. When enabled, it shares a unified Model Gateway, budget ledger, human approval linkage, receipt reconciliation, and OAuth-protected MCP.
Index.harnessFeatTitle:
Decoupled by contract.
Auditable end to end.
Index.harnessFeat1DescSuffix: standard contracts. Each business Core declares its own manifest, permissions, admin pages, and SQL migrations behind pinned deployment locks so base and Cores evolve independently.
Index.harnessFeat1Alt: Compose platform infrastructure with multiple isolated domain Cores via standard contracts
Index.harnessFeat1ScreenshotAlt: Zelo Core package management and capability configuration preview
Index.harnessFeat2Desc: Retain execution records for model calls, tool invocations, and human confirmation. Reconcile unknown outcomes against the original business receipt, subject to current permissions and recovery rules.
Index.harnessFeat2Alt: End-to-end execution trace from intake to verified business receipt
Index.harnessFeat3Desc: Run the zero-Core base standalone, mount a single dedicated domain Core, coexist multiple isolated Cores inside one tenant, and opt into AI Native Runtime and OAuth-protected MCP on demand.
Index.harnessModePlaceholder: Describe your business goal or workflow
Index.harnessModeStandardDesc: Standalone platform API and admin console with built-in multi-tenancy, RBAC, subscriptions, and Core package management.
Index.harnessModeCodeDesc: Mount one domain Core with its isolated migrations and routes, carrying zero unrelated vertical code.
Index.harnessModeMinimalDesc: Run multiple Cores inside one deployment and tenant with strict permission, route, and cache isolation.
Index.harnessModeCordisDesc: Opt into governed AI task orchestration, unified budget accounting, and OAuth-protected MCP transport.
Index.harnessDemoTitle: See Zelo and Business Cores Working Together
Index.harnessDemoDesc: Explore interactive previews demonstrating how the shared base, AI workspace, and official Rental Core coordinate safely.
Index.harnessDemoAlt: Zelo open-source SaaS base and Rental Core demonstration
Index.harnessUse1Desc:
Launch the standalone zero-Core API and admin console out of the box with multi-tenancy, RBAC, subscriptions, and Core package management.

Export a clean base source tarball for your own stack, or book a guided preview running with official Rental Core.
Index.harnessUse1Alt: Zelo dark-mode admin console and AI business workspace preview
Index.harnessUse2Desc:
Deploy Zelo on your own infrastructure and mount CRM, ticketing, rental, or custom vertical Cores on the MIT base—whether for internal delivery or selling your own business packages and paid extensions.

Enable governed AI Native Runtime and OAuth-protected MCP whenever your workflows require them.
Index.harnessUse2Alt: Build, verify, and deploy custom Core hosts on top of the Zelo base
Index.harnessCtaTitle: Build the open SaaS Core ecosystem
Index.harnessCtaDesc: We invite developers and ISVs across industries to build more vertical Cores on Zelo's MIT base and grow the open SaaS ecosystem together. Every Core owns its own repo and license—open-source your core package to grow adoption, and freely sell paid extensions, add-ons, or enterprise delivery.
Index.harnessFeat3Alt: Zelo assembly modes: zero-Core base, single-Core, multi-Core, and optional AI Native
Index.harnessWhyTitleSuffix: lets teams focus on domain logic instead of rebuilding SaaS infrastructure

Index.harnessUse2Inquiry: I would like to discuss Zelo private deployment, custom business Core architecture, and system integrations.

DesktopPreview.conversationQuestion: How do the Zelo base and business Cores work together?
DesktopPreview.conversationIntro: I'm Zelo, an open-source multi-tenant SaaS foundation for AI-native apps. The base provides auth, RBAC, subscriptions, and a shared console, while each vertical plugs in as an independent Core.
DesktopPreview.conversationItem1: Identity & Multi-Tenancy — Two-tier auth, org hierarchy, RBAC trees, and security baselines.
DesktopPreview.conversationItem2: Shared Admin Shell — Unified navigation, theming, subscriptions, and Core page primitives.
DesktopPreview.conversationItem3: Core Lifecycle — Standard manifest checks, online discovery, pinned deployment locks, and independent upgrade and rollback planning.
DesktopPreview.conversationItem4: Base Integrations — Encrypted credential vault, messaging channels, file primitives, and async jobs.
DesktopPreview.conversationItem5: Optional AI Native & MCP — Unified Model Gateway, budget ledgers, approvals, and governed MCP.
DesktopPreview.conversationItem1Compact: Multi-Tenancy — Auth, organizations, and RBAC permission trees.
DesktopPreview.conversationItem2Compact: Admin Shell — Shared console and Core UI primitives.
DesktopPreview.conversationItem3Compact: Core Upgrades — Contract checks, discovery, and deployment locks.
DesktopPreview.conversationItem5Compact: Optional AI / MCP — Governed orchestration, approvals, and receipts.
DesktopPreview.conversationMore: Boot zero-Core standalone, and attach any domain Core when ready.
